subject.title: fix(plugins): scope reply hooks by turn trigger

question: Should `eligibleTriggers` become the supported public plugin API for narrowing `before_agent_reply` dispatch and restart-recovery safety checks?
rationale: This is a new plugin SDK contract with long-lived compatibility semantics; tests can validate the implementation but cannot decide the intended supported API boundary.

options.title: Adopt the scoped hook contract
options.body: Approve `eligibleTriggers` as the generic host-enforced mechanism, provided live restart proof confirms the recovery behavior and legacy registrations remain unrestricted.

options.title: Keep trigger scoping internal
options.body: Avoid a public plugin API addition and pursue a narrower owner-specific implementation only if it can preserve the same fail-closed recovery guarantee.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped hook contract
recommendation.body: Approve `eligibleTriggers` as the generic host-enforced mechanism, provided live restart proof confirms the recovery behavior and legacy registrations remain unrestricted.
